run_manifold_fm_training: run the ManiFM training script with Hydra config to train a Riemannian flow matching model on GPU
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume ManiFM training from the latest checkpoint in the checkpoints directory automatically
configure_training_with_hydra: configure ManiFM training hyperparameters via Hydra CLI overrides for optimizer, data, and validation settings
test_model_with_best_ckpt: test the trained ManiFM model using the best checkpoint and save metrics to metrics.json
enable_wandb_logging: enable Weights and Biases logging for ManiFM training runs by setting use_wandb in config
